passwordReset.subject: Reset your FilamentHub password
passwordReset.heading: Password reset
passwordReset.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your account. Press the button below to set a new one.
passwordReset.note: The link is valid for 1 hour. If you did not request a password reset, simply ignore this email.

emailVerification.subject: Confirm your address — FilamentHub
emailVerification.heading: Confirm your address
emailVerification.intro: You signed up for FilamentHub. Press the button below to confirm this address is yours.
emailVerification.note: The link is valid for 24 hours. You can use the site without confirming — it is what lets you regain access if you forget your password. If you did not sign up, simply ignore this email.
emailVerification.notMeAction: Remove the account opened on this address

emailChange.subject: Confirm your new email — FilamentHub
emailChange.heading: Confirm your new email
emailChange.intro: You requested an email address change on FilamentHub. Press the button below to confirm this address.
emailChange.note: The link is valid for 24 hours. If you did not request an email change, simply ignore this email.

brandStatus.heading: Brand “{brand_name}”
brandStatus.messageApproved: Congratulations! Your request to represent the brand has been approved.
brandStatus.messageRejected: Unfortunately, your request to represent the brand has been declined.

brandInvite.subject: An invitation to officially represent {brand_name} on FilamentHub
brandInvite.subjectGeneric: An invitation to officially represent your brand on FilamentHub
brandInvite.preheader: An invitation to officially represent your brand on FilamentHub. Free for manufacturers.
brandInvite.heading: An invitation to officially represent {brand_display} on FilamentHub
brandInvite.intro: Hello! My name is Ilya, and I am building FilamentHub — a platform for 3D-printing materials.
brandInvite.pitch: We bring filament information together in one place: specifications, printing recommendations, profiles and user reviews. I invite {brand_display} to represent its materials here officially.
brandInvite.benefitsIntro: Once you accept the invitation, you can:
benefits: run official material pages and keep their specifications and descriptions up to date;
link to your website, documentation and stores;
receive user reviews of your materials;
use QR codes on the packaging: a customer scans the code and the material appears in their library together with the current recommended profile, ready to import into OrcaSlicer.
brandInvite.closing: The project is growing right now, so I invite manufacturers personally — so that material information comes straight from the brands and is presented officially.
brandInvite.free: Taking part is free for manufacturers and carries no obligations.
brandInvite.fallbackLink: Button not working? Copy the link:
brandInvite.footer: You received this email because we are inviting {brand_display} to our material catalog. If this is a mistake, write to us at {contact_link} and we will not disturb you again.

brandTeamInvite.subject: An invitation to the {brand_name} team on FilamentHub
brandTeamInvite.heading: You have been invited to the {brand_name} team
brandTeamInvite.intro: Once you accept the invitation you will get the {role_label} role and will be able to work with the brand's official catalog.
brandTeamInvite.note: The invitation is bound to the address it was sent to. Sign in or register on FilamentHub with that same email.
